mapper.select: select count(*) from shop_product where del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from pet_post where del_flag = '0'

select status as status, count(*) as cnt from shop_order group by status
select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as day, count(*) as cnt from shop_order where create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by day
select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as day, count(*) as cnt from shop_product where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by day
select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as day, count(*) as cnt from pet_post where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by day
select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as day, count(*) as cnt from pet_info where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by day
select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as day, count(*) as cnt from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by day
select count(*) from pet_post where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from shop_order where status = '0'
select count(*) from shop_product where del_flag = '0' and stock < #{threshold}

select p.id, p.user_id, p.pet_id, p.content, p.images, p.video_url, p.video_cover, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.del_flag, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.nick_name as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, pi.name as pet_name from pet_post p left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id left join pet_info pi on p.pet_id = pi.id where p.del_flag = '0' order by p.create_time desc limit #{limit}

select id, category_id, product_name, product_images, description, points_price, stock, total_exchange, status, del_flag, create_time, update_time from shop_product where del_flag = '0' order by total_exchange desc limit #{limit}
